# H3 — Throughline adoption arc (the vision's heaviest proof)

**Mission** — Throughline (a real legal product vaulting PII) becomes the deep consumer that proves the kit's governed-LLM spine end-to-end: its hand-wired chat gate chain moves onto `kits/guardrails-pipeline`, its plaintext SQLite vault gains crypto-shred with the kit's conformance suite as the oracle, its investigation UI consumes the `case-file` projection instead of hand-assembly, its case documents get a Tier-2 evidence-acquisition ladder that can *earn* ABSENT_PROVEN, and — only when the trigger fires — its chat ports onto the full agent-harness loop. Every stage replaces a hand-rolled claim path with a kit-verified one, serving the north star: every claim checked against ground truth — the model's, the agent's, and the kit's own.

**Repos & write scope** — Writes: `/Volumes/m2ext/code/geoffmilleraz/throughline` (primary) and `/Volumes/m2ext/code/geoffmilleraz/agentic-kit` (only for pull-queue rows in TRACKING.md and the named kit-side friction deliverables below). `../sextant`, `../growing-gardens-bi`: READ-ONLY.

**Trigger** — Stages 0–4: **ready now** (TRACKING.md:332, roadmap #19: "Subscribers: throughline chat + governed-prose-kit", "Subscribers named in package doc; wiring pending"; roadmap #25: "Throughline UI is the named subscriber"). Stage 5 is **TRIGGER-GATED** — quote from `agentic-kit/docs/plans/2026-07-uplift.md:278`: *"port honestly refused — throughline chat is a single-turn grounded completion, not an agentic loop; forcing the harness would be fake complexity; … full loop port awaits throughline's first agentic workload (M18.1)"*. WARNING: throughline's tracker (`docs/design/26-expansion-tracker.md:540`) uses "M18.1" for the element–evidence linker, DONE 2026-06-12 — that is NOT the trigger. The trigger is a genuinely **multi-turn chat/agentic workload** landing in throughline. Before building Stage 5, verify `app/chat/service.go` is no longer a single `Complete()` per Ask (read the code, not the milestone label). If ambiguous, hand back to Geoff — do not build.

## Design constraints

- **Both repos' gates bind:** stdlib-only in agentic-kit (no `require` block, ever); CUE owns shape (any new kit data contract ships `schema.cue` + `testdata/*.cue`; `vaulttest` is behavioral-only — no schema, per the documented exemption); injected clocks everywhere (`sqlitevault` already takes `clock func() time.Time` — keep that seam through the encrypted rewrite); concurrency contract in every new package doc.
- **Org-agnostic kit:** nothing throughline-specific (case IDs, legal vocabulary, token formats) leaks into kit code; it arrives as config/data.
- **Layering:** `vaulttest` may import only stdlib + `tokenization` (its `testing` import is intentional and documented).
- **Compose, don't duplicate:** the seams are `guardrailspipeline.PreLLMDeps`/`PostLLMDeps`, `tokenization.{Tokenizer,KeyStore,AccessPolicy,ShreddableVault}`, `casefile.Inputs`, `evidencesignature.{ConcernSignature,Scope,Canary,CoverageManifest}`, `evidenceladder.{Tier2,New,WithClock}`, `agentharness.{Config,Deps,Checkpoint}`. If a seam doesn't fit, the answer is an F-row (doctrine amendment 2), never a consumer-side fork of kit logic.
- **Honest non-guarantees:** Shred docs already state what crypto-erasure does NOT guarantee — the throughline vault docs must repeat, not soften, them (and the Stage 2 doc-comment fix must not reintroduce an overclaim). ABSENT_PROVEN claims absence *within declared scope* only (D10) — UI copy must say so.

## Acceptance = proof (machine-checkable only)

- `task validate` green in **both** repos at every stage boundary; agentic-kit `constitution-lint` green; `task downstream-check` green after any kit change (sextant may skip if its tree is still mid-flight — record which consumers ran).
- Kit changes: TRACKING.md (pull-queue rows + package checkboxes) and CHANGELOG.md updated **in the same commit**; `catalog.md` regenerated if any package added.
- Stage 0 proof: `git -C ../throughline status --porcelain` and `git -C ../agentic-kit status --porcelain` both empty.
- Stage 1 proof: `grep -rn "screenAndFence" ../throughline/app` returns **zero hits**, OR every hit is a symbol named verbatim in an open F-row (the F-row's symbol list IS the allowlist — no vague rows); `grep -rn --include='*.go' 'agentic-kit/kits/guardrails-pipeline' ../throughline/app/chat` non-empty (import-path grep — a comment mentioning the package does not count); a test invoking the chain's Run path green; mapping file committed; all `-race`.
- Stage 2 proof: `vaulttest.RunShredConformance` green against the SQLite vault; a test proves plaintext absent from the DB file bytes for a tokenized value (read the raw file, assert no substring match); migration fixture test green; token-stability fixture test green (old DB + old token → Detokenize succeeds); `vault.go` doc comment corrected.
- Stage 3 proof: `grep -rn --include='*.go' 'agentic-kit/foundations/evidence/case-file' ../throughline/app ../throughline/surfaces` non-empty (import grep — string coincidences and comments don't count); a test invoking `casefile.Build` via the projection green; every symbol in the committed deleted-symbol list returns zero grep hits; UI tests green.
- Stage 4 proof: canary test (Tier-2 finds the planted positive via the documented Path convention); ABSENT_PROVEN-requires-Complete() test; unexplained-skip downgrade test; rendered-output test (ABSENT_PROVEN copy iff `Complete()`); all `-race`.
- Stage 5 proof: trigger citation in PR body + harness-backed chat tests green; `grep` shows the old thread loop deleted.
- Fathom anchors above hand-verified (`find_callers`/`find_symbol`) while the `verify` test_reaches bug stands (`RunShredConformance` is expected-absent pre-Stage-2); do not let a red buggy verify block a hand-proven push, and do not let it pass unexamined either.

## Non-goals & theater traps

- Do NOT build: a new guardrails chain (exists: `kits/guardrails-pipeline`); a deterministic-token vault option (F1 closed: `WithDeterministicTokens`); budget middleware (F3/F4 closed: `llminstrument.WithBudget`, already adopted by throughline); RunOnce (F7 closed); a case-file aggregator (roadmap #25 graduated); a glob Tier-2 (exists: `direct-investigator`); byte-position parsing in the kit without an F-row and Geoff's nod.
- Do NOT port the full harness because Stage 5 is written down — the Wave-2 oracle already refused this once as fake complexity. Building it untriggerred is the defect, not the deliverable.
- Theater traps: (1) wiring `PreLLMChain` *alongside* `screenAndFence` and calling it adoption — the proof is donor deletion under the verbatim-allowlist grep; (2) an "encrypted" vault that still writes plaintext audit values or leaves old rows unencrypted — the raw-bytes test exists to catch exactly this (and note the current doc comment already lies about encryption; don't repeat that move); (3) rendering `CaseFile` fields but still computing support scores locally — the named donors (`ElementCoverage*`, `confidenceForTier`, the web-handler summing) are the check, and the mapping needs coordinator sign-off before merge; (4) an ABSENT_PROVEN badge not backed by `Complete()` — the rendered-output test catches this; an overclaim here is a defect class equal to a failing test; (5) marking Stage 0 done without Geoff's actual commits — the porcelain checks are the proof; (6) satisfying a presence grep with a comment — acceptance greps import paths in `.go` files and requires an invoking test.

## Dependencies & hand-back

- Per the H0 index (`docs/plans/handoff-h0-index.md`) dependency spine **H1 → (H2 → H3 ∥ H4)**: this spec runs **after H2**, in parallel with H4. Concretely: Stage 2's kit-side `vaulttest` package must not land while doctrine amendment 2's blocking asks (D35-3/4/5, TRACKING.md:422–424) remain open — H2 closes them; if H2 has not, escalate to Geoff for an explicit waiver rather than asserting "consumer-proven" unilaterally. Stage 0 blocks everything; Stages 1–4 are then independently landable (disjoint file sets); Stage 5 blocks on its trigger.
- Kit-side F-rows and the `vaulttest` package land under normal kit review; tag no release without Geoff.
- Report to Geoff: Stage 0 request first (both pending trees); then per-stage: donor symbols deleted (with the committed list), F-rows filed, conformance/canary/token-stability results, and — for Stage 5 — the trigger evidence or a "not fired, not built" statement. Needs his sign-off: Stage 0 commits, any F-row that changes a kit contract (`Segment` positions, `Canary` document-store form, chain semantics), plaintext-migration strategy choice, Stage 3 donor mapping, Stage 5 go/no-go.

**Size & team** — XL overall (L without Stage 5). Suggested shape: Opus coordinator + 3 Sonnet implementers in ≤4-agent waves — Stage 1 (chat), Stage 2 (vault + kit `vaulttest`), Stage 3 (case-file) run parallel post-Stage-0 on disjoint files (Stage 2's kit half waits on the H2/doctrine gate above); Stage 4 solo after 3; Stage 5 solo, trigger-gated, coordinator-verified.
